caption: The drawing depicts a quilt composed of various square panels, each bordered by alternating red and blue rectangles featuring floral and geometric patterns. The quilt has a dark blue border with light, intricate floral linework. The central section of the quilt contains eight beige squares with appliqué designs, primarily consisting of botanical motifs such as flowers, leaves, and what appears to be fruit or pods, with dominant colors of green, brown, red, pink, blue, and orange. One beige square in the lower row features a blue vase with green leaves, orange and blue flower elements, and a pair of pink birds facing each other. The quilt’s overall layout alternates these decorated beige squares with red squares that have small repeating yellow blossom patterns. The edges and some internal dividers are created with a dark blue fabric decorated with contrasting light floral outlines, completing a grid composition with a repeated motif structure.
title: Applique Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
